content: The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 was on **August 11, 1999**. It was a total solar eclipse that was visible across parts of Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, with the path of totality crossing through countries including the UK, France, Germany, Austria, Hungary, Romania, Turkey, Iran, and India.
